title: SWF: ActionGetURL and ActionGetURL2 for loadMovie
description: Verify ActionGetURL (0x83) and ActionGetURL2 (0x9A) compile correctly for loadMovie(), loadMovieNum(), getURL(). In AS2: loadMovie('url', target) → ActionGetURL2; getURL('url', '_blank') → ActionGetURL. Check packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts for these. Fix if missing. Add tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/loadmovie.test.ts.
